sources.source: Wegge et al., Speed-of-sound measurements in (argon + carbon dioxide), 2016
sources.accessRoute: NIST publication repository public manuscript and ThermoML discovery
sources.notes: High-quality primary acoustic source, but compositions are 25.019 and 49.896 mol% Ar and therefore outside the requested priority systems and existing low-Ar CCS scope.

sources.source: Fernandez-Vicente et al., Speeds of sound for a biogas mixture, 2016
sources.accessRoute: publisher, EURAMET/CORE repository and arXiv-indexed manuscript
sources.notes: Primary row-level tables are traceable, but the mixture is methane-rich rather than a dry high-CO2 CCS stream.

sources.notes: No primary binary CO2+H2S row-level speed-of-sound matrix was found; pure-gas handbook values and EOS/software calculations were rejected as validation evidence. Worth revisiting if an acid-gas resonator dataset is published.
